The '''Breeder''' was an ancient [[Rakata/Legends|Rakata]] who lived in the years of their people's [[Infinite Empire/Legends|Infinite Empire]]. His name stemmed from the fact that he was known to have created countless monstrous and horrific animals which he left within a jungle prison vault on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Belsavis/Legends|Belsavis]]. The passion of the Breeder was the art of creation with the beasts he crafted being his greatest achievement. He was also responsible for the imprisonment of a fellow Rakata within a [[mind prison]] who later took the name of the [[Vengeful One]] as he desired revenge against the Breeder. However, the Breeder died thousands of years ago and during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the Vengeful One instead shifted his vengeance onto the Breeder's abominable creations who he tasked to a [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] member that awakened him.<ref name="TOR" />
